name: system_async_task
description: Async task primitives for background work with polling/blocking get

functions.name: delay
functions.description: Returns a task that resolves to value after ms milliseconds

functions.name: sleep
functions.description: Blocks current thread for ms milliseconds

functions.name: ready
functions.description: Returns true if task has completed

functions.name: get
functions.description: Blocks until task completes and returns result; throws on rejection

functions.name: error
functions.description: Returns error message if rejected; empty string otherwise
